notice: Fictional held-out evaluation data. Alder Crossing, Port Wren, Stone Hollow and every company, date, number and quote in these documents are made up.
story: A term sheet, a Council vote that failed 3 to 4, and an agreement nobody signed. Every term stays at proposed except the staff recommendation. The same 18 apartments, sixty percent income limit and 2055 end date appear in every record, so no term differs.

claims.quote: Quarry Row Homes LP has asked the City to freeze the taxable value of the former quarry parcel for ten years.
Eighteen of the ninety apartments would be reserved for lower-income renters.
Households earning no more than sixty percent of area median income would qualify.
Rent plus utilities would be capped at thirty percent of the qualifying income.
The restrictions would run through December 31, 2055.
claims.review_note: An end date, not a number of years.

claims.quote: Staff recommends that the Council grant the assessment freeze only if the set-aside is written into a recorded agreement.
claims.value: Freeze only with a recorded agreement

claims.quote: The Economic Development Director said the applicant offers eighteen income-restricted apartments out of ninety.
claims.review_note: The vote on this item failed.

claims.quote: The applicant's representative stated that the company is willing to keep the restrictions in place until the end of 2055.
claims.review_note: The vote on this item failed.

claims.quote: A motion to grant the ten-year assessment freeze failed on a vote of 3 to 4.
claims.review_note: A failed motion is not support.

claims.quote: The Council directed staff to return with a written agreement before the request is heard again.
claims.review_note: The vote on this item failed.

claims.quote: Quarry Row Homes LP shall keep eighteen (18) of the ninety (90) apartments as income-restricted apartments.
An income-restricted apartment may be rented only to a household whose income is at or below sixty percent of area median income.
The monthly rent for an income-restricted apartment, with utilities, may not be more than thirty percent of sixty percent of area median income for the household size.
claims.value: 30 percent of 60 percent of area median income

claims.quote: Sections 2 through 4 stay in force through December 31, 2055.
Quarry Row Homes LP and each successor in title are bound by this Agreement.
claims.value: Quarry Row Homes LP and each successor

claims.quote: Every year by April 15, Quarry Row Homes LP shall send the City a rent roll showing the income and rent for each income-restricted apartment.
If a violation continues for more than 45 days after notice, the City may end the assessment freeze and bill the taxes that were not collected.
The City shall hold the taxable value of the parcel at its 2025 level for ten years.
claims.value: Taxable value held for ten years
